scope: SITES local disposable Miniflare / D1 / R2

provenance.scenario: Entire timeline and discussions are authored synthetic engineering test data, not a transcription or record of owner learning.
provenance.historicalStartingPoint: Issue #112 read-only inventory: an owner-private planning Project, 15 Steps, three Questions, 11 Articles, one Library area and two Stage 1 checkpoints. None are exported here.
provenance.reusedPriorFixture: tests/fixtures/pr30/fixtures/mood-music.json and tests/fixtures/pr30/examples/mood-race.mjs inspired the API uncertainty, race and personal-feedback cases.
provenance.runtime: Only results of executed test commands in the PR report count as observed execution; code paths and fictional Notes do not independently prove tests ran.
provenance.provider: All tracks, names and responses are fictional local mocks. No Spotify token, audio-features claim, OAuth session or provider request.

states.question: What is planned, and what is only an assumption?
states.expect: Project, three Questions, Library reference; no practical Note or verified provider access.

states.question: Why is Spotify not wired in yet?
states.expect: Research Note, revised provider Question and provisional offline fallback decision.

states.question: How did the cards and controls change?
states.expect: v1 and v2 source references, linked implementation Notes, checkpoint.

states.question: What was broken, how was it shown, and which version fixed it?
states.expect: v3 and v4 Notes, issue Question revision, linked annotation/Flag, race decision.

states.question: What is current, what was abandoned, and what remains unverified?
states.expect: The Project genuinely revises its four-stage shape to add a personal-label stage; v5 personal labels, superseded objective retained, conflicting and missing evidence, unrelated record excluded.

states.theme: Unfinished return, raw evidence and Library authoring request
states.question: What did the User actually observe, what is merely inferred, and what reference should be requested?
states.expect: User-authored incomplete persistence inference, open Question, supplied terminal capture and a request brief; no generated Library article, C01 correction or checkpoint is pre-seeded.

states.theme: Learner returns to the Library and flags questions
states.question: What do the short Flags and annotations mean, and what did the User actually write?
states.expect: Two new User Notes, two one-sentence annotations and a passage Flag. GPT-produced Library material is optional, never a scripted fixture answer.

states.theme: Reported refresh experiment and first persistence prototype
states.question: Which code version exists, what was reported and what was independently executed?
states.expect: User Notes mention an observed refresh result and real runnable v6 source; terminal output is explicitly supplied, not verified. Existing GPT output, if any, remains accessible.

states.theme: Interruption, shared-device concern and conflicting evidence
states.question: What is still uncertain despite a seemingly successful persistence test?
states.expect: Additional short annotations/Flags and longer User Notes question privacy, source and the meaning of test evidence.

states.theme: Second React revision chooses explicit storage consent
states.question: How has source v7 changed the decision, and which earlier comments remain relevant?
states.expect: Runnable v7 opt-in/clear source, supplied terminal evidence, new User reflections and another return to previously flagged passages.

states.theme: Cold-context return after a longer gap
states.question: Can a new GPT reconstruct the accumulated history and identify one useful next step?
states.expect: Nineteen synthetic User Notes, short passage annotations, multiple Flags, available code versions and optional GPT-authored Library/Question/checkpoint outputs without an imposed answer.

artifacts.change: Experiments with automatic browser-local label persistence

remainingProjectModels: Selected for later separate tests: authorised retired HTB Cap and Automatic Plant-Screamer. Neither is implemented in this fixture.

reservedOutputs.noteAuthority: GPT must not create or rewrite User-authored Notes; optional outputs require an explicit simulated User request, not the seeded Note itself.
reservedOutputs.requirements: The article is absent at phase F; a test conversation must request it, inspect editorial policy and existing references, save/read back the actual output, and record quality and UI observations rather than comparing against canned teaching text.

evaluation.cleanup: Exact known outputs only, including manuscript receipt-derived ID; safe fail-closed behavior on unknown records
evaluation.repeatability: Fresh TEST ONLY D1 after clearing test-user data replays the same starting snapshot, while optional conversational outputs persist across session advances; end-to-end generation and UI require separate observation
